<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Welcome to Module 2 of the FFPS CQI training series where we will provide an overview of the Evidence-Based Practice measurement framework.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Select “Next” to begin." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="As you learned in Module 1, the CQI process is a cyclical process of problem-solving that requires the deliberate use of data & evidence. In order to work effectively, the CQI process needs a viable infrastructure within which to function – the CQI process MUST be supported and informed by an effective CQI system which is a coherent set of structures, functions, policies and procedures or system features that facilitate the CQI process.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="With a thru-line of equity and inclusion in every component – the key features of an effective CQI system are:
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="72" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="45" ListLevel="1" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Organizational Commitment and Capacity - where leadership support, administrative oversight and measurable outcomes are emphasized
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="72" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="45" ListLevel="1" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="CQI Plans, Policies and Procedures where CQI training and resources are emphasized, and
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="72" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="45" ListLevel="1" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Data Infrastructure and Processes where data collection, analysis and reporting are emphasized – in this module, you will learn about the Prevention-Focused Measurement Framework that will provide the data infrastructure needed to inform California’s FFPS CQI activities at the county and state-levels. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="45" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="45" ListLevel="1" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="-27" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="The Prevention-Focused Measurement Framework is a key component in California's FFPS CQI system." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" ListLevel="1" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletChar="•" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Let’s move on to Lesson 2, which is an overview of the Evidence-Based Practice Measurement Framework." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="To measure the extent to which preventive services are reaching children, youth, and families, the Measurement Framework suggests tracking measures in four domains. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Each domain shown below has a comprehensive lesson and post-test. After you complete a domain, you will be redirected back to this screen and won’t be able to progress to lesson 3 until you have viewed all four domains.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Select a domain below to learn more." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Let’s discuss the capacity domain. Capacity refers to measures that assess the degree to which the agency devoted the necessary resources to support its implementation of preventive services. Here, agency might be the child welfare agency or other coordinating agencies involved, such as the Department of Health, mental health, juvenile justice, or probation." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="In the capacity domain there are a few areas that may be measured including:
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Staffing, which could be the processes for hiring and selecting qualified staff, clarity of roles and responsibilities, staffing gaps, workload, and knowledge and skills 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Training, which might be formal, time limited, and structured events, such as webinars, in services, and training modules 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="And coaching, which might include ongoing, day-to-day, and more informal guidance provided by a knowledgeable peer, supervisor, or coach that reinforces effective use of practices, processes, and tools used to support implementation
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Depending on the jurisdiction, agencies may be overseeing capacity via direct county services or may be supporting capacity as a communication support. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="What other areas could be measured in the Capacity domain? Think about this as you are reviewing the information in this lesson." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="SinglePt5"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Some Capacity measures are standard and can be collected for most EBPs, while others are model-specific and depend on the requirements outlined by the model developer or purveyor. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="SinglePt5"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Let's explore which capacity measures are standardized compared to those that are model specific." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="For most preventive services, the following capacity measures can be collected and tracked. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Provider location, contracted EBP's provided by the agency, the total number of full-time model practitioners per agency, the total number of part-time model practitioners per agency, the total number of supervisors per agency, the total number of internal coaches per agency, the total number of internal model trainers per agency, the total number of external coaches per agency, and the total number of external model trainers per agency.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="It’s important to note the asterisk appearing next to a few capacity measures. For some models, the role of internal or external coaches or trainers is not allowed. The model purveyor is the only entity that can train or provide coaching. They don’t provide a train of trainers." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="While there are a set of standardized capacity pressures that are relevant to most EBPs and other preventive services, there are some that are model specific. The following are specific to each EBP. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Supervisor to practitioner ratio, caseload for full time and part time staff, and recommended duration of services. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Select the PDF button below to access a comprehensive list of the ratios, caseloads, and duration for varying models." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Now that we have reviewed the capacity domain, let's explore a few practical applications of how capacity data can be used for CQI activities. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Select the buttons below to learn more.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Capacity data can be used to assess practitioner capacity by reviewing the number of full-time model trained practitioners and supervisors across provider agencies. This data can also be used to determine whether staffing levels are sufficient to meet current service needs and maintain caseload expectations. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Capacity data can also be used to review caseload distribution by analyzing average monthly caseloads for full time practitioners, identifying workload imbalances , and exploring strategies to build caseload equity across the workforce. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Capacity data can be used to monitor model training status by tracking the number of staff who've completed required model training. This information can be used to identify staff in need of additional or refresher training and support ongoing adherence to model requirements. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="And lastly, capacity data can be used to track provider site coverage by monitoring the number and geographic distribution of provider sites delivering each EBP. This data can be used to assess whether current site locations align with community needs and support equitable access to services." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Good job! You’ve completed the Capacity Domain section! Let’s check our learning before moving on.Select the button below to start." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Question #2. Which of the following is NOT an example of a model-specific Capacity measure? 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Option 1: Supervisor to practitioner ratio,
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Option 2: Caseload for full-time and part-time staff,
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Option 3: Number of supervisors per agency,
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="or Option 4: Recommended duration of services " /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Let's discuss the reach domain. Reach refers to the degree to which the service is reaching the target population through eligibility determination, referrals, and service uptake. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Some preventive services, particularly the well supported EBPs, will have their own recommended Reach measures and should be included, while others may have none." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="In the reach domain, there are categories of suggested measures. The following are suggested standardized reach measures. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Eligible Title IV-E Agency-Involved Candidates
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="Eligible Community Pathway Candidates
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="EBP Referrals to Providers
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="EBP Service Uptake
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Arial"> <BulletPicture Size="0x0" /> </ListStyle> </Style> <Span Text="EBP Service Completion 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Let’s take a look at each of these standardized Reach measures." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="As you learned in Module 1, in Family First implementation we ultimately want to make sure that children and families are achieving the outcomes the EBP is designed to help them achieve, as well as the child welfare outcomes the agency is looking to achieve. Quality casework practice and quality service delivery provide the pathway for families to reach these desired outcomes. So, those casework practices and service delivery processes conducted at the local level are what need to be examined in a CQI process to understand what adjustments or changes for improvement are needed along the way. This quality practice to outcomes visual provides the whole picture of what this pathway to outcomes entails and emphasizes the true partnership between the child welfare agency and provider community. It should be noted that the information on this slide reflects general or typical casework practices and service delivery processes. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="27" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="The outcomes pathway begins with the quality casework practices executed by the child welfare agency – the child welfare agency is responsible for:
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="100" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="74" ListLevel="2" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Identifying families who are candidates for receiving an EBP based on the candidacy definition in the states approved prevention plan
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="100" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="74" ListLevel="2" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Conducting an accurate assessment of the family’s needs and developing an aligned prevention plan jointly with the family, then
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="100" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="74" ListLevel="2" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Referring the family to the appropriate service based on the needs identified, and 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="100" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="74" ListLevel="2" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Conducting a warm hand-off to the provider agency in a way that supports the family's participation in the service
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="27" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Next the EBP Provider executes quality service delivery by:
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="100" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="74" ListLevel="2" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Accepting (or rejecting) the referral 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="100" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="74" ListLevel="2" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Supporting getting the family enrolled in and actually starting the service
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="100" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="74" ListLevel="2" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Delivering the service with fidelity to the requirements outlined by the EBP developer
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="100" TrailingMargin="0" FirstLineMargin="74" ListLevel="2" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Ideally leading to successful completion of the service by the family
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="27" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="How well case work practices are conducted and how well services are delivered should be tracked and monitored and adapted or adjusted all along this pathway
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="27" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Ideally leading to the desired EBP outcomes and desired CW outcomes." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Good job! You’ve completed the Reach Domain section! Let’s check our learning before moving on.Select the button below to start." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Let’s discuss the Fidelity domain. Fidelity refers to the extent to which the service is carried out with adherence to the intended approach. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Some preventive services, particularly the well-supported EBPs, will have their own recommended fidelity measures and should be included, while others may have none." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Fidelity measures can be organized into 3 categories. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Capacity which involves resources the agency devotes to the work to implement the EBP with fidelity to implementation guidelines, processes, and quality standards. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Process which is how the services were delivered, the type, frequency, intensity, duration, and timeliness of the services. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Quality which is how well the services were delivered, often captured by observations, interviews, focus groups, and surveys." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Each preventive service has its own specific fidelity requirements, measures, tools, instruments, and reports. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Here are a few examples of model-specific fidelity measures.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Healthy Families America measures the percentage of direct service staff who receive weekly supervision. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Multisystemic Therapy measures the percentage of therapist who have obtained a master’s degree in social work or counseling. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Parents as Teachers measures the percentage of children who received a complete annual child developmental screening during the program year. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Parent-Child Interaction Therapy measures the percentage of therapists who complete at least 3 hours of PCIT Continuing Education credits. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="As you can see, the model-specific Fidelity measures vary across different EBPs. We will discuss resources that outline additional Fidelity measures for each EBP in Lesson 3." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Now that we have reviewed the fidelity domain, let's explore a few practical applications of how fidelity data can be used for CQI activities. Fidelity data may be used to evaluate provider performance by assessing provider success in meeting targets for fidelity measures. Where gaps exist, agencies might consider contributing factors and explore county support options, such as targeted training or resources. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Fidelity data may be used to address implementation challenges. If issues are identified, collaboration between providers and the model developer/purveyor may be helpful to develop solutions. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Fidelity data may be used to develop establish a fidelity monitoring plan. Counties and providers should develop a plan to regularly track and monitor fidelity data to ensure adherence. You will learn more about this in Module 4. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="And, lastly, look for patterns in fidelity data and use those patterns to identify where additional supports or resources need to be strengthened." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Good job! You’ve completed the Fidelity Domain section! Let’s check our learning before moving on.Select the button below to start." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Question 1. True or False. Fidelity refers to the extent to which the service is carried out with adherence to the intended approach.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Option 1: True,
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Option 2: False" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Question 2. Which Fidelity category relates to how well the prevention services were delivered?
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="A. Capacity
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="B. Quality
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="C. Quantity
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="D. Process" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Let’s discuss the last domain: Outcomes. Outcomes refer to the extent to which services achieved the desired results for children and families. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Outcomes may be prescribed by the model developer/purveyor, are of interest to the agency, or are required for federal reporting." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Let’s review the federally required outcome measures. The Family First Prevention Services Act Requires jurisdictions to track and report two long term outcomes for candidates. Foster care entry at exactly 12 months from the start date of the child-specific prevention plan.Foster care placement status within 24 months of the start date of the child-specific prevention plan.Click the link to learn more about the federally required outcome measures that are outlined in Revised Technical Bulletin #1." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Let’s review the California-specific outcome measures. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="For Family Maintenance, Voluntary Family Maintenance, and 602 youth, agencies should look at the number and percent of these candidates from the start date of their child-specific prevention plan 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="For FM and VFM, this includes collecting data on these children following closure who have a substantiated allegation which results in re-opening a case within 12 months of the opening of their child-specific prevention plan. Additionally, agencies should collect the allegation type to assess if the allegation is consistent with the previous allegation type. For Probation, they should assess if the formal petition is filed and wardship." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="Now that we have reviewed the outcomes domain, let's explore a few practical applications of how outcome data can be used for CQI activities. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="None" ListTypeFormat="Parentheses" Color="#000000" BulletFont="Arial" /> </Style> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Assess outcome data. Review outcome data to determine if target populations are achieving expected improvements. Identify disparities across demographic groups and explore strategies, such as tailored interventions, to support equitable outcomes. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Agencies should evaluate data quality and completeness by confirming that data is being collected consistently across sites using the required tools. Identify missing or inconsistent data and provide support to improve accuracy and completeness. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" Color="#000000" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="Outcomes data can be used to track progress over time by reviewing outcome performance in relation to establishing benchmarks. Identify underperforming areas and explore targeted strategies for improvement. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style FlowDirection="LeftToRight" LeadingMargin="36" TrailingMargin="0" LineSpacingRule="Single" LineSpacing="20"> <ListStyle ListType="Bullet" ListTypeFormat="Plain" BulletChar="·" BulletFont="Symbol" /> </Style> <Span Text="And lastly, Outcomes data can be used to monitor program completion by reviewing completion rates of each EBP. Agencies should evaluate associations between program completion and intended outcomes." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Good job! <Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="To support the implementation of the EBPs included in California’s 5-year State Prevention Plan, CQI policy briefs have been created. These briefs provide counties and providers with a comprehensive framework for implementing the EBPs. ​
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Select the link to learn more and download the briefs." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="To support the regular review of data, providers should pull fidelity and outcome data from their own systems or spreadsheets or complete the report template for each EBP. " /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="This data should be used to examine differences in indicators by gender, race, and ethnicity, as defined in Revised Technical Bulletin #1, which is necessary for identifying potential disparities in program outcomes and addressing them through county CQI Implementation Teams. <Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Question #4, The measure “the total number of external coaches” is an example of a measure in which domain of the Measurement Framework?

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Below, you can review key terms from Module 1. Select each term to learn more.Title IV-E – Title IV of the Federal Social Security Laws provides grants to states for aid and services to needy families with children and for child-welfare services. Part E describes the Federal payments for foster care, prevention, and permanency.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Family First Prevention Services Act (FFPSA) signed into law 2018 with the goal of helping children remain at home, reducing the unnecessary use of congregate care, and building the capacity of communities to support children and families.Evidence-Based Practices (EBPs) – Evidence-Based practice involves identifying, assessing, and implementing strategies that are supported by scientific research.Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) – an ongoing way of working that uses data, regular team learning, testing, and reflection to strengthen services and improve results for families over time. 
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Measurement Framework is a roadmap that helps agencies decide what to measure and track to understand how well child welfare preventive services are working. Home Visiting EBPs:Healthy Families America (HFA) is a home visiting program for new and expectant families with children who are at-risk for maltreatment or adverse childhood experiences.Parents As Teachers (PAT) is a home visiting parent education program that teaches new and expectant parents skills intended to promote positive child development and prevent child maltreatment.Nurse Family Partnership (NFP) is a home visiting program that serves young, first-time, low-income mothers beginning early in their pregnancy until the child turns 2 Homebuilders provides intensive, in-home counseling, skill building, and support services for families who have children (0–18 years old) at imminent risk of out-of-home placement or who are in placement and cannot be reunified without intensive in-home services.Family Check-Up (FCU) aims to improve parenting skills and family management practices, with the goal of improving a range of emotional, behavioral, and academic child outcomes" /> </Block> </Content> </Document>

<Document xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <Content> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Below, you can review key terms from Module 1. Select each term to learn more.
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="
" /> </Block> <Block> <Style /> <Span Text="Mental Health EBPs:Functional Family Therapy (FFT LLC) aims to address risk and protective factors that impact the adaptive development of 11- to 18-year-old youth who have been referred for behavioral or emotional problems.Functional Family Therapy (FFT Partners) aims to address risk and protective factors that impact the adaptive development of 11- to 18-year-old youth who have been referred for behavioral or emotional problems.Multisystemic Family Therapy (MST) is an intensive treatment for youth delivered in multiple settings. MST aims to promote prosocial behavior and reduce criminal activity, mental health symptomology, out-of-home placements, and illicit substance use in 12- to 17-year-old youth.Brief Strategic Family Therapy (BSFT) uses a structured family systems approach to treat families with children or adolescents (6 to 17 years old) who display or are at risk for developing problem behaviors including substance abuse, conduct problems, and delinquency.Parent Child Interaction Therapy (PCIT) is an intensive, evidence-based treatment for children aged 2 to 7 and their parents or caregivers and aims to reduce externalizing behavior problems in children, enhance positive parenting practices, and strengthen the parent-child relationship. Motivational Interviewing is a collaborative, strengths-based approach to engaging individuals and supporting behavior change." /> </Block> </Content> </Document>
